comment: RSI(14) boundary cases. Case 1: strictly rising closes -> every delta is a gain -> RSI = 100 exactly. Case 2: strictly falling closes -> RSI = 0 exactly. Warm-up for RSI(14) needs 15 candles (14 deltas), so leading nulls = 14. Wilder's original 1978 worked example is not reproducible offline with confidence, so the canonical boundary cases are used instead.
